_comment: Monthly retention REMINDER for the durable team memory and the Foundry housekeeping run (delta D-RC-W1; governance/MEMORY_POLICY.md section 3, operations/RETENTION_AND_CLEANUP.md section 4, RUNBOOK.md M5). This workflow deliberately performs NO deletion and calls NO script: it posts the section 4 checklist to the platform Teams channel and opens the monthly ticket, so the owner runs the rehearsal, reviews the read-only listing and approves the apply step under their own identity. A memory purge requires a named human approver (cleanup_foundry.py --memory --apply --approved-by <upn>), which an unattended workflow cannot hold - so wiring --apply in here would defeat the control it is meant to serve. The Logic App identity needs nothing beyond the Teams webhook and the ticket connection; it holds no Foundry data-plane role.

teamsWebhookUrl._comment: Channel {teams:infosec-assurance-platform}. Key Vault reference resolved by the Logic App managed identity (infra/logicapp.bicep).

ownerUpn._comment: Accountable owner; the only principal who may pass --approved-by on a memory purge (team/TEAM_MODEL.md).

ticketWebhookUrl._comment: Opens the monthly ISMS housekeeping ticket. Leave the app setting empty to skip the ticket step - the reminder still posts.

inputs._comment: Second of the month, after the monthly evaluation review (RUNBOOK M1) has produced its evidence note.

Post_checklist_to_Teams._comment: Notification only - no approval gate, no submission of record (governance/HUMAN_APPROVAL.md).

body.text:
🗂 Monthly retention and cleanup run (@{formatDateTime(utcNow(),'yyyy-MM')}) — owner @{parameters('ownerUpn')}

Procedure: @{parameters('retentionDocPath')} (calendar entry RUNBOOK.md M5). Nothing has been deleted by this message.

1. Offline rehearsal — `python3 scripts/cleanup_foundry.py --dry-run` (no Azure session needed): confirms the horizons read from setup/.env match MEMORY_POLICY.md §3.
2. Read-only listing — `python3 scripts/cleanup_foundry.py --all`. File the console output as Governance/Operations/@{formatDateTime(utcNow(),'yyyy')}-@{formatDateTime(utcNow(),'MM')}/retention-run.md.
3. Review the candidate list. Confirm vs-assurance-memory and vs-assurance-combined are NOT in it (check C2).
4. Approve, then `--apply`.
5. Expired team notes additionally need `--memory --apply --approved-by "@{parameters('ownerUpn')}"` — a named human approver, which is why this workflow never runs the apply step itself.

A quiet month still produces the evidence note.

Open_housekeeping_ticket._comment: Opens the tracking ticket only. The ticket body repeats the checklist; it grants no approval and triggers no deletion.

body.summary: ISMS monthly: retention and cleanup run @{formatDateTime(utcNow(),'yyyy-MM')}
body.description: Run @{parameters('retentionDocPath')} (RUNBOOK.md M5). Attach the --dry-run rehearsal and the read-only --all listing as evidence before any --apply. A --memory purge needs --approved-by.
